title: add stepwise RAG walkthrough CLI tutorial and local dev runner
author: Maya Chen
description: Provide a focused, tutorial-style quickstart that walks a developer through building a stepwise Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) flow using the Redwood CLI and a local dev runner. Motivation: many users ask for a minimal, step-by-step learning path that demonstrates progressive claims (index -> retrieval -> grounding -> tool-calling) and maps each step to telemetry hooks and tests. This PR introduces a compact quickstart under quickstarts/rag-stepwise-cli and an opinionated local runner (rundev) that emulates streaming responses and shows token-level cost estimates. The change includes a tutorial README with checkpoints, an example small dataset, a light-weight indexer script, a local Node dev server with a single tool shim (web-search stub), and CI smoke tests to validate end-to-end flow. Checklist: 1) README tutorial content + checkpoints added, 2) CLI dev runner implemented and documented, 3) example dataset and index script included, 4) one tool shim with clear extension points, 5) tests for smoke run and structured-output assertions, 6) docs site link updated. Related linear tasks ENG-2143 and ENG-2201. See commits and review conversation for details and decisions on API surface and telemetry hooks.
